summary: Web code fences consult a generated Pierre supported-language gate before loading the highlighter; unknown labels remain plain text without importing the highlighter.

replay.detail: Presentation only; stored events are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Supported Pierre language IDs and aliases retain highlighting; labels additionally ignore surrounding whitespace.

manual.detail: None; the language gate is regenerated during web builds.

recovery.detail: No data migration or recovery required.
